_comment: Frozen configuration for the M110 comparison sheet.
`exposure` and `crops` are written ONCE by `python sheet.py scout` and then
left alone. Freezing them is the point: an exposure or a crop re-chosen per
arm lets each arm show itself at its best, which is how a comparison lies.
Subjects are the owner's own labelled stacks under D:\personal\macro,
which is STRICTLY READ-ONLY -- nothing here ever writes there.

subjects.name: bee-3-cpl
subjects.why: the adversarial case for a negative-lobe kernel: thousands of hairs, every one its own occluding edge (fact 1374)

crops.why: geometric corner, 48px inset; radial max for lateral CA

subjects.name: wrapped-text-1
subjects.why: the non-hair control: hard high-contrast printed edges, where ringing is easiest to see and hardest to excuse

crops.why: geometric corner, 48px inset; radial max for lateral CA
